info.name: EBS Storefront Collections Setup
info.description: Run once with a valid adminAccessToken to create the initial merchandising collections. Shop By Crops is intentionally omitted because it already exists. Product membership is assigned separately through products.assignedCollections.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Best Sellers",
  "slug": "best-sellers",
  "description": "Popular products selected for our customers.",
  "isActive": true,
  "priority": 1,
  "bannerTitle": "Best Sellers",
  "subCollections": []
}

exec: pm.test('Best Sellers collection created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().success).to.eql(true); });

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Shop By Disease & Pest",
  "slug": "shop-by-disease-pest",
  "description": "Browse products by the pest or disease affecting your crop.",
  "isActive": true,
  "priority": 3,
  "bannerTitle": "Shop By Disease & Pest",
  "subCollections": [
    { "name": "Mustard Aphid", "slug": "mustard-aphid", "isActive": true },
    { "name": "Paddy Sheath Blight", "slug": "paddy-sheath-blight", "isActive": true },
    { "name": "Gram Pod Borers", "slug": "gram-pod-borers", "isActive": true },
    { "name": "Rice Blast", "slug": "rice-blast", "isActive": true },
    { "name": "Bacterial Leaf Blight", "slug": "bacterial-leaf-blight", "isActive": true },
    { "name": "Helicoverpa armigera", "slug": "helicoverpa-armigera", "isActive": true }
  ]
}

exec: pm.test('Disease & Pest collection created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.subCollections).to.have.lengthOf(6); });
pm.test('New Arrivals collection created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().success).to.eql(true); });
